description: Engine live wiring + sealed snapshots. Orchestrates the planning-engine canon over tenant-loaded inputs (ports-injected, no direct I/O), maps the portfolio through the kpi-catalog dataState envelope, and seals one immutable snapshot per tenant-day (plan_seal) with a SHA-256 payload hash and the ENGINE_VERSION/SCHEMA_VERSION stamps (L-07). H8 refuses the rate seed before any ref is computed; H6-style replay returns the stored seal untouched — a divergent replay is disclosed, never applied (M8 owns restatement).
